cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

# libs/storage-postgres (fulla::storage::postgres) -- M2b Task 18,
# fulla-sdk-refactor (design.md §5.5/§6/§8 "ORM 模型（归
# storage-postgres，评审 F2）"). Holds the drogon::orm-generated ORM model
# classes (Oauth2*/Users/Roles/etc, generated by drogon_ctl -- DO NOT
# EDIT the generated files) that MUST NOT live in the Domain layer
# (design.md §4.1 rule 1: Domain forbids drogon::orm just like it forbids
# drogon:: in general). This is the Adapter-layer package design.md
# assigns them to.
#
# Scope note (Task 18 slice 1): this slice only RELOCATES the 14 ORM
# model files (verbatim, generator output unchanged) from
# OAuth2Plugin/include/oauth2/models/ + OAuth2Plugin/src/models/ into this
# new package, and updates every #include call site across the tree
# (OAuth2Plugin/OAuth2Server) to the new path. It deliberately does NOT
# yet move the Postgres repository IMPLEMENTATIONS (PostgresOAuth2Storage,
# Postgres{Client,Grant,Token,Consent,Role,SubjectMapping,User}Repository,
# still under OAuth2Plugin/src/storage/) or add the ORM<->Domain DTO
# mapping layer design.md's "DTO 映射" calls for -- those are separate,
# larger slices. OAuth2Plugin depends on this package now (correct
# direction per design.md's package table: storage-postgres is its own
# Adapter-layer package, independent of and parallel to OAuth2Plugin,
# which is free to consume it) instead of owning the ORM models itself.
#
# models_backup/ (OAuth2Plugin/models_backup/) is the drogon_ctl
# regeneration scratch directory -- ephemeral, gitignored, NOT a migration
# source (design.md's explicit note) -- untouched by this move.

list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../cmake")
if(NOT DEFINED FULLA_PROJECT_VERSION)
    set(FULLA_PROJECT_VERSION 1.3.2)
endif()
if(NOT COMMAND oauth2_apply_compat)
    include(Compatibility)
endif()
if(NOT COMMAND oauth2_apply_warnings)
    include(Warnings)
endif()

project(fulla-storage-postgres VERSION ${FULLA_PROJECT_VERSION} LANGUAGES CXX)

find_package(Drogon CONFIG REQUIRED)

add_library(${PROJECT_NAME} STATIC)
add_library(fulla::storage::postgres ALIAS ${PROJECT_NAME})

target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME}
    PUBLIC
        $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>
        $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
    PRIVATE
        # ORM-generated model .cc files emit quote-includes of sibling
        # model headers (e.g. #include "Oauth2Clients.h" from
        # Oauth2AccessTokens.cc) -- generator output is exempt from
        # rewrite (same rationale OAuth2Plugin/CMakeLists.txt documented
        # for this exact include path before the move).
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/fulla/storage/postgres/models
)

file(GLOB FULLA_STORAGE_POSTGRES_SOURCES "src/models/*.cc")
target_sources(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE ${FULLA_STORAGE_POSTGRES_SOURCES})

# The drogon_ctl ORM-generated model sources above are exempt from rewrite
# (regeneration would lose any hand-edit), so the unused-parameter warnings
# they emit at /W4 resp. -Wextra (e.g. updateArgs()'s unused `id` /
# `isForCreation`) and the deprecated std::codecvt usage flagged by Clang
# (-Wdeprecated-declarations) are silenced at the SOURCE level here instead
# of touching generated code or lowering the warning level of the whole
# target -- the handwritten Postgres*.cc sources below stay at full warning
# level.
if(MSVC)
    set_source_files_properties(${FULLA_STORAGE_POSTGRES_SOURCES}
        PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "/wd4100")
else()
    set_source_files_properties(${FULLA_STORAGE_POSTGRES_SOURCES}
        PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-Wno-unused-parameter;-Wno-deprecated-declarations")
endif()

# Task 19: PostgresIdentityRepository.cc implements libs/identity's
# repository interfaces (IUserRepository/IRoleRepository/
# ISubjectMappingRepository) against the ORM models this package already
# owns. Correct dependency direction (design.md §4.1): storage-postgres
# is an Adapter-layer package, free to depend on the Domain-layer
# libs/identity (implements its interfaces); identity itself has zero
# dependency back on storage-postgres.
#
# Task 24 slice 5: PostgresMfaRepository.cc/PostgresWebAuthnRepository.cc/
# PostgresSocialAccountRepository.cc implement libs/identity's remaining
# repository interfaces (IMfaRepository/IWebAuthnRepository/
# ISocialAccountRepository), same placement rationale.
#
# Phase 2 (Postgres backend slice of the oauth2 storage refactor): relocate
# the 6 oauth2 Postgres repository files
# (PostgresRepositoryBase/PostgresClientRepository/PostgresGrantRepository/
# PostgresTokenRepository/PostgresConsentRepository/PostgresRepositoryBundle)
# verbatim from OAuth2Plugin/{include,src}/oauth2/storage/ into this package,
# namespace rewritten to fulla::storage::postgres. The 4 concrete
# repositories implement fulla::oauth2::repository::* interfaces, so
# this target now links fulla::oauth2 (correct direction: oauth2 is a
# Domain-layer package with zero dependency on storage-postgres; verified
# no circular dep -- libs/oauth2/CMakeLists.txt does not link storage).
target_sources(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    src/PostgresIdentityRepository.cc
    src/PostgresMfaRepository.cc
    src/PostgresWebAuthnRepository.cc
    src/PostgresSocialAccountRepository.cc
    src/PostgresRepositoryBase.cc
    src/ClientOwnersRepository.cc
    src/OrgConsentRepository.cc
    src/OrgConsentRequestRepository.cc
    src/OrgSuccessionRepository.cc
    src/AdvisoryLock.cc
    src/PostgresClientRepository.cc
    src/PostgresGrantRepository.cc
    src/PostgresTokenRepository.cc
    src/PostgresConsentRepository.cc
    src/PostgresRepositoryBundle.cc
)

target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME} PUBLIC Drogon::Drogon fulla::identity fulla::oauth2)

set_target_properties(${PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 17 CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

oauth2_apply_compat(${PROJECT_NAME})
oauth2_apply_warnings(${PROJECT_NAME})
oauth2_apply_gcov(${PROJECT_NAME})
oauth2_apply_sanitizer(${PROJECT_NAME})  # #104: instrument product code in sanitizer builds

include(GNUInstallDirs)
install(DIRECTORY include/fulla DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR})

# SDK packaging: install-tree + build-tree find_package() config carrying the
# transitive find_dependency() closure (fulla-sdk-refactor Task 28a).
if(NOT COMMAND fulla_package)
    include(FullaPackage)
endif()
fulla_package(
    TARGET ${PROJECT_NAME}
    PACKAGE fulla-storage-postgres
    EXPORT_NAME storage::postgres
    DEPENDENCIES Drogon fulla-identity fulla-oauth2
)
